snippet.title: GLITCH KARTS
snippet.description:
WELCOME TO GLITCH KARTS! Play as your favourite GLITCH character but ALSO checkout the ALL NEW BLACK FRIDAY MERCH! We have new figurines, plushies and more AND A STORE-WIDE SALE UP TO 40% OFF! Only at: https://glitchprod.store SALE ENDS DEC 2nd

Also if you want to play the game... some say that somewhere on the GLITCH store website you can...

Game by @b0tster, music by @JaredCarey (https://x.com/JaredCareyMusic), website programming by Xenova (https://x.com/_xenova), special thanks to @GlitchyPSI as well for website help!
